ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels localized in the central lobe regions versus 55% low-intensity black pixels localized on the margins and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white zones located in the center-left and center-right of the fluke lobes. These are surrounded by a thick, irregular black boundary. Numerous low-intensity speckles are visible within the right-side white zone, with a larger, irregular dark mass situated near the interior-bottom margin of the left-side white zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 140 degrees and a shallow depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations extending across the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel-amplitude (larger jagged peaks) at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve following the trailing edge from the median notch out towards the tips, with a slight convex curvature along the leading edge margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique C-shaped dark pigmentation cluster located on the lower-right boundary of the left lobe's white interior region.
